name: 90021 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90021 (Los Angeles) has 67 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90021 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90021 (Los Angeles) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.7 times the typical level).
